name: Ushakiran Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Ushakiran Finance Ltd is in the business of investments and financing.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
UKFL is an investment and finance company, registered under the category of Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit-taking non-banking Financial Company, with assets 
less than Rs. 100 Crs. The co., apart from investments and financing activities, also undertakes financial and consulting services like preparation of project reports, loan syndications, capital, and debt restructuring, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.63 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.01% over last 3 years.
